title: Practice 6: при- and у-: arriving, and leaving

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: I have a friend coming over to visit tomorrow.
exercises.why: **приезжает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of приезжать: imperfective (perfective partner: приехать).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: What time is the plane coming on Friday?
exercises.why: **прилетает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of прилетать: imperfective (perfective partner: прилететь).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
